Below is a quick‑reference list of the **national long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” here means a statutory holiday that fell on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a three‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| **April 7** | Good Friday | Friday | **Apr 7 – 9** (Fri‑Sun) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | **May 20 – 22** (Fri‑Mon) |
| **Sep 4**  | Labour Day | Monday | **Sep 2 – 4** (Fri‑Mon) |
| **Oct 9**  | Thanksgiving | Monday | **Oct 7 – 9** (Fri‑Mon) |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | **Dec 23 – 25** (Fri‑Mon) |

> **Note:**  
> - **New Year’s Day** (Jan 1) fell on a Sunday, so it did not create a long weekend.  
> - **Canada Day** (Jul 1) fell on a Saturday, so it did not create a long weekend.  
> - **Boxing Day** (Dec 26) fell on a Tuesday, so it did not create a long weekend.  

---

### Provincial / Territorial Variations

Canada’s provinces and territories have additional statutory holidays that can also create long weekends. Below are a few examples that were observed in 2023:

| Province/Territory | Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|--------------------|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario | **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Monday) | **Feb 18 – 20** |
| British Columbia | **Vancouver Island Day** | Apr 28 (Monday) | **Apr 26 – 28** |
| Manitoba | **St. Petersburg Day** | Apr 28 (Monday) | **Apr 26 – 28** |
| New Brunswick | **New Brunswick Day** | Jun 19 (Monday) | **Jun 17 – 19** |
| Newfoundland & Labrador | **St. John’s Day** | Jun 19 (Monday) | **Jun 17 – 19** |
| Nova Scotia | **Natal Day** | Jun 19 (Monday) | **Jun 17 – 19** |
| Prince Edward Island | **St. George’s Day** | Jun 19 (Monday) | **Jun 17 – 19** |
| Quebec | **Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day** | Jun 24 (Saturday) | No long weekend (falls on weekend) |
| Yukon | **Yukon Day** | Jun 19 (Monday) | **Jun 17 – 19** |
| Northwest Territories | **National Indigenous Peoples Day** | Jun 21 (Wednesday) | No long weekend (falls mid‑week) |
| Nunavut | **Nunavut Day** | Jun 21 (Wednesday) | No long weekend (falls mid‑week) |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> If you need a province‑specific list, you can pull the holiday calendars from the official provincial government websites or use a public API such as the *Canadian Holidays API* (e.g., https://date.nager.at/Api). This will give you the exact dates for each jurisdiction, including any changes for 2023.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the full provincial breakdown or if you’re targeting a specific region!
